files.purpose: Configure Jac 0.36.1 [project] with name insuraagent-backend, kind service and entry-point main.jac; no npm dependencies and no model settings (byllm ships with jaclang).

Typed data model, no imports. Enum DenialReason with members NOT_MEDICALLY_NECESSARY, OUT_OF_NETWORK, PRIOR_AUTH_MISSING, EXPERIMENTAL_OR_INVESTIGATIONAL, CODING_ERROR, BENEFIT_EXCLUSION, OTHER; enum AppealStrength with WEAK, MODERATE, STRONG, VERY_STRONG. Value objects PolicyClause(section, title, text, relevance_note default ""), Contradiction(denial_quote, policy_quote, clause_section, explanation) and AppealLetter(subject, salutation, body, citations: list[str], closing). Persistent nodes Claim (claim_id, patient_name, member_id, cpt_code, date_of_service, billed_amount: float, denial_text, clinical_record default ""), Policy (policy_id, plan_name, full_text) and Appeal (appeal_id, claim_id, policy_id, denial_reason: DenialReason, strength: AppealStrength, contradictions_json: str holding a serialized list of contradiction dicts, letter_subject, letter_body, citations_json: str holding a serialized list of citation strings, created_at: str).

signatures.DenialReason: enum DenialReason { NOT_MEDICALLY_NECESSARY, OUT_OF_NETWORK, PRIOR_AUTH_MISSING, EXPERIMENTAL_OR_INVESTIGATIONAL, CODING_ERROR, BENEFIT_EXCLUSION, OTHER }
signatures.AppealStrength: enum AppealStrength { WEAK, MODERATE, STRONG, VERY_STRONG }
signatures.PolicyClause: obj PolicyClause { has section: str, title: str, text: str, relevance_note: str = ""; }
signatures.Contradiction: obj Contradiction { has denial_quote: str, policy_quote: str, clause_section: str, explanation: str; }
signatures.AppealLetter: obj AppealLetter { has subject: str, salutation: str, body: str, citations: list[str], closing: str; }
signatures.Claim: node Claim { has claim_id: str, patient_name: str, member_id: str, cpt_code: str, date_of_service: str, billed_amount: float, denial_text: str, clinical_record: str = ""; }
signatures.Policy: node Policy { has policy_id: str, plan_name: str, full_text: str; }
signatures.Appeal: node Appeal { has appeal_id: str, claim_id: str, policy_id: str, denial_reason: DenialReason, strength: AppealStrength, contradictions_json: str, letter_subject: str, letter_body: str, citations_json: str, created_at: str; }

files.purpose: Imports os, json, re, Model from jaclang.byllm.llm, and DenialReason, PolicyClause, Contradiction, AppealLetter, AppealStrength from models.jac. _pick_model() returns a Model chosen from environment variables in this order: FEATHERLESS_API_KEY -> Model(model_name=APPEAL_MODEL env or "openai/Qwen/Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct", api_key=that key); ANTHROPIC_API_KEY -> "claude-sonnet-4-20250514"; GEMINI_API_KEY -> "gemini/gemini-2.5-flash"; OPENAI_API_KEY -> "gpt-4o-mini"; otherwise raise Exception naming the four variables. Module-level glob llm = _pick_model(); every by-llm function uses `by llm()` and returns str, with a docstring prompt (sem) above it. _parse_json_obj(s): empty -> {}; strip; if a ```json or ``` fence wraps a {...} (regex r"```(?:json)?\s*(\{.*?\})\s*```", DOTALL) use the captured group, else take the substring from the first "{" to its matching "}" by counting brace depth (no "{" or unbalanced -> {}); json.loads it, returning {} on any exception. _parse_json_list(s) is identical with "["/"]" and returns []. extract_denial_reason: raw = extract_denial_reason_raw(text).strip().upper(), then the first matching substring rule wins: "NOT_MEDICALLY_NECESSARY" -> NOT_MEDICALLY_NECESSARY; "OUT_OF_NETWORK" -> OUT_OF_NETWORK; "PRIOR_AUTH" -> PRIOR_AUTH_MISSING; "EXPERIMENTAL" or "INVESTIGATIONAL" -> EXPERIMENTAL_OR_INVESTIGATIONAL; "CODING" -> CODING_ERROR; "BENEFIT_EXCLUSION" or "EXCLUSION" -> BENEFIT_EXCLUSION; else OTHER. assess_appeal_strength: raw upper-cased and stripped; "VERY_STRONG" or "VERY STRONG" -> VERY_STRONG; else "STRONG" -> STRONG; else "WEAK" -> WEAK; else MODERATE. extract_relevant_clauses and find_contradictions call their _raw function once, run _parse_json_list, skip elements that are not dicts, and build PolicyClause / Contradiction with each field str(d.get(key, "")). draft_appeal_letter calls draft_appeal_letter_raw once with all ten arguments, runs _parse_json_obj, takes cites = d.get("citations") or [], wraps a non-list cites as [str(cites)], and returns AppealLetter with subject, salutation, body, closing as str(d.get(key, "")) and citations as [str(c) for c in cites]. Each public tool makes exactly one model call.

signatures.extract_denial_reason_raw: def extract_denial_reason_raw(denial_text: str) -> str by llm();
signatures.extract_relevant_clauses_raw: def extract_relevant_clauses_raw(policy_text: str, denial_reason: DenialReason) -> str by llm();
signatures.extract_relevant_clauses: def extract_relevant_clauses(policy_text: str, denial_reason: DenialReason) -> list[PolicyClause]
signatures.find_contradictions_raw: def find_contradictions_raw(denial_text: str, clinical_record: str, clauses: list[PolicyClause]) -> str by llm();
signatures.find_contradictions: def find_contradictions(denial_text: str, clinical_record: str, clauses: list[PolicyClause]) -> list[Contradiction]
signatures.draft_appeal_letter_raw: def draft_appeal_letter_raw(patient_name: str, member_id: str, claim_number: str, date_of_service: str, cpt_code: str, billed_amount: float, plan_name: str, denial_reason: DenialReason, contradictions: list[Contradiction], clinical_record: str) -> str by llm();
signatures.draft_appeal_letter: def draft_appeal_letter(patient_name: str, member_id: str, claim_number: str, date_of_service: str, cpt_code: str, billed_amount: float, plan_name: str, denial_reason: DenialReason, contradictions: list[Contradiction], clinical_record: str) -> AppealLetter

signatures.submit_claim: walker:pub submit_claim { has patient_name: str; has member_id: str; has claim_number: str; has date_of_service: str; has cpt_code: str; has billed_amount: float; has plan_name: str; has denial_text: str; has policy_text: str; has clinical_record: str = ""; can run with Root entry; }
signatures.list_appeals: walker:pub list_appeals { can run with Root entry; }

files.purpose: Thin service entry: only `import from walkers { submit_claim, list_appeals }` so both public walkers are registered and importable from main.

verify.flow: submit_claim (5 mocked tool calls) -> Claim/Policy/Appeal on root -> list_appeals
verify.steps: Run jac check main.jac and the Jac behavior tests. Tests set OPENAI_API_KEY to a placeholder before importing tools.jac, then assign tools.llm = MockLLM(model_name="mockllm", config={"outputs": [...]}) with one string output per by-llm call, in call order (denial reason, clauses JSON, contradictions JSON, strength, letter JSON for submit_claim).

assumption: Backend slice of the InsuraAgent JacHacks Spring app (fozagtx/insuraAgent). The React frontend, app.jac, the CLI demo main.jac, the ReAct orchestrator and the probe/smoke scripts are out of scope; main.jac is a new thin entry that imports the two walkers.
